title: Search And Destroy
gameText: Deploy on table. During every draw phase, unless opponent's character of destiny < 4 occupies a battleground site, opponent loses 1 Force. Biker scouts are forfeit +1. Effect canceled unless your characters of destiny < 4 occupy two battleground sites.
evidence: Stats, subtype, uniqueness and credit circles inspected in full image/crop sheets; Episode I checked in dedicated right-edge strip. Wording compared against old printing: punctuation, ordering or equivalent phrasing only. Standard rules limit battle participants to own cards; Local Trouble preserves that normal rule.

title: Security Precautions
